title: Unpaid Client Invoice
summary: This story details a situation where a major recurring customer refused to pay a $125,000 invoice, creating conflict between Sales and Finance. The owner analyzed the financial health, negotiated a compromise involving a one-time courtesy discount and deferring the remaining balance, which secured the payment while preserving the long-term relationship.

key_points.text: Customer refused to pay $125,000 that was owed
Conflict between Sales and Finance regarding writing off the amount
Analyzed internal system and discovered the project would remain net positive overall without the payment
Proposed a compromise: write off half of the unpaid amount as a one time courtesy discount
The remaining balance would be deferred into a future project
This win-win solution prevented a potential financial loss and protected the long-term relationship
